_readme: Edit freely. label = display name, type = tag on the tile, description = caption in the viewer, wovlo = credit as Wovlo Studio work. Non-Wovlo designs are presented as redesign concepts.

digital-cat-and-dog-treats.label: Cat & Dog Treats
digital-cat-and-dog-treats.description: A mobile store for pet treats. A bold orange hero with a playful "Pet-Approved Zoomies" headline leads into product and trust sections, with a free-shipping bar and an always-reachable cart.

digital-fragrance.label: Home Fragrance & Candles
digital-fragrance.description: A warm, earthy mobile design for a clean-ingredient candle and room spray brand. A lifestyle hero, star-rating social proof and a seasonal "Shop Autumn Favorites" call to action keep the focus on the products.

digital-garment-care-products.label: Garment Steamer
digital-garment-care-products.description: A light, editorial mobile design for a combined iron and steamer. A calm blue palette and a simple "press, steam and go in minutes" message make the product feel effortless.

digital-hygiene.label: Plant-Based Cleaning
digital-hygiene.description: A premium mobile design for plant-based home cleaning products. A serif headline with an italic accent, a high-contrast black call to action and review stars give everyday cleaning a luxury feel.

digital-ice-pops.label: Organic Ice Pops
digital-ice-pops.description: A playful, high-energy design for chef-crafted organic ice pops, designed for both mobile and desktop. Bold magenta and purple type pairs with clear actions to find pops nearby or book a pop party.

digital-jewelry.label: Jewelry
digital-jewelry.description: A minimal, editorial mobile design for a jewelry brand. A large portrait hero lets the pieces speak, with restrained navigation and generous white space.

digital-kids-apparel.label: Kids Apparel
digital-kids-apparel.description: A soft, neutral mobile design for baby and kids clothing. Warm photography and gentle typography communicate comfort and quality at first glance.

digital-outdoor-apparel.label: Outdoor Apparel
digital-outdoor-apparel.description: A clean mobile design for outdoor and travel apparel. A full-width group shot and the "Pack Less. Do More." message position the clothing around real use.

digital-pet-treats.label: Allergy-Friendly Dog Treats
digital-pet-treats.description: A mobile design for fresh, allergy-friendly dog treats. A warm cream and tan palette, product-pack photography and a 4.8-star rating build trust for owners of sensitive pups.

digital-pumpkin-spice.label: Pumpkin Spice Energy Mix
digital-pumpkin-spice.description: A seasonal mobile design for a pumpkin spice energy drink mix. Autumn leaves, a hand-held product shot and a five-star review line sell the limited-time flavor.

digital-scent-candle.label: Luxury Scented Candles
digital-scent-candle.description: A dark, moody mobile design for luxury candles inspired by hotel lobbies. The "Your Personal Scent Concierge" message and a glowing candle hero set an upscale tone.

digital-seed-crisps.label: Seed Crisps
digital-seed-crisps.description: A fresh, friendly mobile design for seed-filled crisps. A confident serif headline, a deep green "Shop the crisps" button and playful product packs make snacking feel premium.

digital-skin-care.label: Sensitive Skin Care
digital-skin-care.description: A soft peach mobile design for a skincare line for sensitive skin. Large product photography, a free-shipping bar and a clean cart-first header keep shopping quick.

digital-skin-glow.label: Natural Skin Serums
digital-skin-glow.description: A natural-look mobile design for undiluted, sensitive-skin serums. Products on stone and sand tones back the "Nature, undiluted" message, with money-back and free-delivery reassurance.

digital-whey-protein.label: Grass-Fed Whey Protein
digital-whey-protein.description: A bold, trust-led mobile design for grass-fed whey protein. A strong "There's a reason we're #1" headline, lab-tested badges and shipping guarantees support a high-contrast black call to action.

social-behind-the-scenes.label: Your Order's Journey
social-behind-the-scenes.description: A five-slide carousel that walks followers through what happens to an order from checkout to their door, using warm photography and large, friendly type.

social-bigbang-lightstick.label: Bigbang Lightstick Pre-order
social-bigbang-lightstick.description: Vertical story ad for an official lightstick pre-order. Black and gold styling, a glowing product hero and a diagonal "Slots this batch" ribbon create urgency.

social-bts-lightstick.label: BTS Lightstick Pre-order
social-bts-lightstick.description: Vertical story ad for an official lightstick pre-order in the fan group's lavender palette, with a large product image and a limited-slots ribbon.

social-christmas-bonus.label: Christmas Bonus
social-christmas-bonus.description: A festive red announcement post with a shopping-bag-toting model, a Christmas tree and a handwritten wishlist note, inviting followers to claim their holiday bonus.

social-cosrx-skincare-favorites.label: Korean Skincare Starter Kit
social-cosrx-skincare-favorites.description: Three-part story set featuring a five-step Korean skincare starter kit built around a popular brand's favorites, ending with a prompt to comment or message a wishlist.

social-favorite-skincare.label: Spill Your Holy Grails
social-favorite-skincare.description: A friendly, lime-and-purple engagement post asking followers for their skincare holy grails, shown in portrait and feed-sized versions.

social-first-batch-is-open.label: First Batch Is Now Open
social-first-batch-is-open.description: Launch announcement for the first order batch with its open dates, using torn-paper shapes, sticker details and a winking model for a lively, on-brand feel.

social-group-buy-discount.label: Buy Together, Bigger Savings
social-group-buy-discount.description: Explains tiered group-buy discounts of 3%, 5% and 10% with starburst badges, branded boxes and a shopping bag, so the savings are understood at a glance.

social-group-lightsticks.label: Official K-pop Lightsticks Collection
social-group-lightsticks.description: Teases an upcoming batch of official lightsticks with a lineup of products on a pink pedestal, trust icons and a "Reserve yours now" button.

social-how-it-works.label: How It Works
social-how-it-works.description: Four-slide educational carousel that explains the ordering process step by step, with a dotted path, simple icons and a clear "Start here" opening.

social-katseye-lightstick.label: Katseye Lightstick
social-katseye-lightstick.description: Teaser story asking "Is your lightstick ready?" ahead of a release, built around a silver product image on a soft lavender background.

social-linkedin-post.label: Traffic vs Conversions
social-linkedin-post.description: A B2B thought-leadership post about websites that get traffic but not sales. A simple funnel diagram (ad, landing page, product page, cart, checkout) leads to a "Book a discovery call" button.

social-product-disclaimer.label: A Little Note About Our Products
social-product-disclaimer.description: A clear, friendly disclaimer explaining that product photos are for illustration, brand names belong to their owners, and actual items may vary slightly.

social-romandnd-makeup-favorites.label: Your Go-To Makeup Shade
social-romandnd-makeup-favorites.description: A colorful makeup engagement post asking followers for their go-to product or shade, with lip tints, cushion and palette product shots and a "Message us now" prompt.

social-shipped-from-korea.label: Shipped Direct From Korea
social-shipped-from-korea.description: A set of posts showing that products ship straight from Seoul, with trust icons for real Korean brands, direct sourcing and reliable delivery.

social-teaser.label: We're Coming Back
social-teaser.description: A vibrant purple teaser, styled as a parcel label with a "Coming Back" stamp, announcing the shop's return with K-beauty, K-makeup and K-pop finds.

social-torriden.label: Cica Soothing Cream
social-torriden.description: A fresh green product spotlight for a soothing cica cream, pairing a model applying the cream with a close-up jar and clear ingredient callout.

social-voucher-post.label: ₱50 First Order Voucher
social-voucher-post.description: A welcome-voucher post that offers a ₱50 discount on a first purchase, featuring a smiling model holding the voucher and gift boxes.

banners-5-off-banner.label: 5% Off Your Next Korean Find
banners-5-off-banner.description: Wide promotional banners offering 5% off, with shoppers, product boxes and a bold "Your next Korean find is here" message.

banners-cover-photo.label: Discover More. Shop Wovlo.
banners-cover-photo.description: Cover photos for the brand's social pages, introducing the shop ("Discover more. Shop Wovlo") with branded shopping bags and category cues for K-beauty, makeup and K-pop.

banners-join-the-waitlist.label: Join the Waitlist
banners-join-the-waitlist.description: Compact banners inviting people to join the waitlist and start their own business, showing the app on a phone beside branded parcels.

banners-mobile-app-banner.label: Shop From Korea
banners-mobile-app-banner.description: A small in-app banner with a night-street Seoul backdrop and a lime "Shop now" button promoting K-beauty, skincare and more.

appstore-budget-tracker.label: Budget Tracker
appstore-budget-tracker.description: One of my first graphics for Improbable Labs. Four App Store thumbnails that introduce receipt scanning, saving, and organizing spending by category, on a bright blue background.

appstore-color-scanner.label: Color Scanner
appstore-color-scanner.description: One of my first graphics for Improbable Labs. Four App Store thumbnails for a color scanner app: detect colors in real time, see HEX and RGB values, save them, and browse the full library.

appstore-monthly-planner.label: Monthly Planner
appstore-monthly-planner.description: One of my first graphics for Improbable Labs. Four App Store thumbnails for a planner app, covering the daily schedule, a calendar view, quick plan creation, and event history in a soft sky-blue style.

appstore-pokemon-card-scanner.label: Pokemon Card Scanner
appstore-pokemon-card-scanner.description: One of my first graphics for Improbable Labs. Five App Store thumbnails for a card scanner app: scan, search, collect, and check each card's market value, in a bold red trading-card style.

appstore-workout-timer.label: Workout Timer
appstore-workout-timer.description: One of my first graphics for Improbable Labs. Three App Store thumbnails for a workout timer app, with a dark, high-energy look showing timer and audio cues, custom workouts, and presets.
